answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Chartered emergency dispatcher log with control room certification, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 504 fakes spends 6552 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The raven of the design is public, the nadir of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the ember of honest work is what finally pays. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
